# Leeframes Studio

> Leeframes Studio is a performance creative studio in Seoul, founded in 2026. It makes Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad creatives, AI video and AI-made lookbooks for DTC fashion and accessory brands, and runs the media buying that scales the winning ads.

## Services

- Meta ad creative production: statics, video, founder ads, creator (UGC) ads and AI video
- AI lookbook and campaign imagery, no photoshoot required
- Media buying on Meta: the same team that makes the ads runs and scales them
- Creative only or full service

## Who it works with

DTC brands selling physical products that already spend on Meta, especially fashion, jewellery and accessories. Brands in the portfolio include 6A, Akoihaus, Cleartype, Coffery, Produktepr and YAR.

## How it works

Three steps: brief, first drafts, final files.

## Contact

Get a quote: https://leeframes.com/quote.html or hello@leeframes.com
